items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, Johnny Ray. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah! Oh he was -- and he'd go into this thing and chase everybody out of the place with his coat off, and that business, you know.

ctx.x: knew it. But he just loved to play. He told -- zooma, zooma, zooma, zooma, zooma, zooma -- you know? And he said what key is it? What key is it? I -- do I do so and so? I'd say E flat, I think, or G, or whatever it was. Okay, and we hit it off, and he say he wanted to do -- uh, Ray -- where he pull off the coat, left your hat on, and cry, and everything?
Yeah! Oh he was -- and he'd go into this thing and chase everybody out of the place with his coat off, and that business, you know.
